questions.stem: A wave has a frequency of 50 Hz. What is its period?
questions.explanation: Period T = 1/f = 1/50 = 0.02 s. The period is the reciprocal of the frequency.

questions.stem: On a displacement-distance graph, which wave property can be measured directly from the x-axis?
questions.explanation: On a displacement-distance graph, the x-axis shows distance along the wave, so wavelength (the distance between two consecutive points in phase) can be measured directly. Frequency and period require a displacement-time graph.
